diff:
--- a/tests/test-design.json
+++ b/tests/test-design.json
@@ -1 +1,152 @@
-{}
+{
+  "task_id": "LABEL-NORMALIZATION",
+  "contract_version": 1,
+  "cases": [
+    {
+      "id": "empty-input",
+      "intent": "Rule 10: empty input returns an empty list.",
+      "input": "",
+      "expected": []
+    },
+    {
+      "id": "empty-label-forms",
+      "intent": "Rules 1, 2, 5, 6, 9: separators, empty quotes and ordinary whitespace produce no labels.",
+      "input": ",,,\"\", \t\r\n\u000b\f,\"\"\"\",,",
+      "expected": []
+    },
+    {
+      "id": "separator-order",
+      "intent": "Rules 1, 6, 8, 10: repeated separators preserve first occurrence order after trimming and lowercasing.",
+      "input": ", BETA ,, Alpha, GAMMA, beta, ,",
+      "expected": ["beta", "alpha", "gamma"]
+    },
+    {
+      "id": "quote-concatenation",
+      "intent": "Rules 2, 8: quote toggles anywhere concatenate adjacent fragments and lowercase all letters.",
+      "input": "PRE\"MiD\"POST,\"A\"B\"C\"\"D\",X\"\"Y",
+      "expected": ["premidpost", "abcd", "xy"]
+    },
+    {
+      "id": "quoted-commas",
+      "intent": "Rules 1, 2, 8: commas in quotes remain literal even in a partially quoted label.",
+      "input": "\"A,B,,C\",D\",E\"F,\",\"",
+      "expected": ["a,b,,c", "d,ef", ","]
+    },
+    {
+      "id": "escaped-delimiters-outside",
+      "intent": "Rules 1, 2, 3, 8: escaped comma, quote and backslash are literals outside quotes.",
+      "input": "A\\,B,A\\\"B,A\\\\B",
+      "expected": ["a,b", "a\"b", "a\\b"]
+    },
+    {
+      "id": "escaped-delimiters-inside",
+      "intent": "Rules 1, 2, 3, 8: the same escapes are literals inside quotes and escaped quotes do not toggle mode.",
+      "input": "\"A\\,B\\\"C\\\\D\",END",
+      "expected": ["a,b\"c\\d", "end"]
+    },
+    {
+      "id": "all-ordinary-whitespace",
+      "intent": "Rules 5, 6, 8: all six ASCII whitespace characters trim at boundaries and collapse together internally.",
+      "input": " \t\r\n\u000b\fA \t\r\n\u000b\f B\f\u000b\n\r\t ",
+      "expected": ["a b"]
+    },
+    {
+      "id": "all-quoted-whitespace",
+      "intent": "Rules 2, 5, 7, 8: quoted whitespace preserves every character and repetition at boundaries and internally.",
+      "input": "\" \t\r\n\u000b\fA  \t\tB\f\u000b\n\r\t \"",
+      "expected": [" \t\r\n\u000b\fa  \t\tb\f\u000b\n\r\t "]
+    },
+    {
+      "id": "all-escaped-whitespace",
+      "intent": "Rules 3, 5, 7, 8: escaping each of the six whitespace characters protects it, including label boundaries.",
+      "input": "\\ \\\t\\\r\\\n\\\u000b\\\fA\\ \\ B\\\f\\\u000b\\\n\\\r\\\t\\ ",
+      "expected": [" \t\r\n\u000b\fa  b\f\u000b\n\r\t "]
+    },
+    {
+      "id": "protected-breaks-runs",
+      "intent": "Rules 5, 6, 7: quoted and escaped whitespace break ordinary runs, which collapse separately on each side.",
+      "input": "A \t\"\t\t\"\r\n B,A \t\\\t\r\n B",
+      "expected": ["a \t\t b", "a \t b"]
+    },
+    {
+      "id": "mixed-protected-boundaries",
+      "intent": "Rules 6, 7, 8: outer ordinary whitespace trims while protected spaces and tabs remain at boundaries.",
+      "input": " \t\"  \"A\"\t\" \r, \n\\ B\\\t\f ",
+      "expected": ["  a\t", " b\t"]
+    },
+    {
+      "id": "empty-quotes-do-not-break-runs",
+      "intent": "Rules 2, 6, 9: removed empty quote delimiters emit nothing and do not separate ordinary whitespace runs.",
+      "input": " \"\" A \t\"\"\r\n B \"\" ,\"\" \t\"\"",
+      "expected": ["a b"]
+    },
+    {
+      "id": "protected-only-and-dedup",
+      "intent": "Rules 7, 9, 10: protected whitespace-only labels survive and deduplicate by exact output, retaining distinct lengths.",
+      "input": "\" \t\r\n\u000b\f\",\\ ,\" \",\"  \",\"\", \t",
+      "expected": [" \t\r\n\u000b\f", " ", "  "]
+    },
+    {
+      "id": "dedup-after-all-normalization",
+      "intent": "Rules 2, 3, 6, 8, 10: equivalent quoted, escaped, trimmed and case-varied labels deduplicate in first occurrence order.",
+      "input": " Z,ALPHA,\"z\",a\\LPHA, alpha ,BETA,Z,\"BE\"TA",
+      "expected": ["z", "alpha", "beta"]
+    },
+    {
+      "id": "exact-whitespace-equality",
+      "intent": "Rules 6, 7, 10: equality uses normalized strings regardless of protection while distinct protected spacing stays distinct.",
+      "input": "A B,A\tB,\"A B\",\"A  B\",A\\ B,\" A B \"",
+      "expected": ["a b", "a  b", " a b "]
+    },
+    {
+      "id": "other-ascii-literals",
+      "intent": "Rules 5, 8: punctuation, digits and non-whitespace ASCII controls remain exact while letters lowercase.",
+      "input": "AZ09!@#$%^&*()_+-=[]{};:'/?<>.|~`\u0000\u001b\u007f",
+      "expected": ["az09!@#$%^&*()_+-=[]{};:'/?<>.|~`\u0000\u001b\u007f"]
+    },
+    {
+      "id": "escaped-uppercase-both-modes",
+      "intent": "Rules 3, 8, 10: escapes consume exactly one character and escaped uppercase lowercases in either mode.",
+      "input": "\\A\\Z,\"\\A\\Z\",\\n\\t\\r",
+      "expected": ["az", "ntr"]
+    },
+    {
+      "id": "paired-backslash-before-delimiter",
+      "intent": "Rules 1, 2, 3: paired backslashes emit a literal backslash and leave the following comma or quote active.",
+      "input": "A\\\\,B,\"C\\\\\",D\\\\",
+      "expected": ["a\\", "b", "c\\", "d\\"]
+    },
+    {
+      "id": "trailing-escape-outside",
+      "intent": "Rules 4, 9, 10: a trailing unpaired escape invalidates the whole input after valid, duplicate and empty labels.",
+      "input": "OK,ok,,\"\",BAD\\",
+      "expected": null
+    },
+    {
+      "id": "trailing-escape-inside",
+      "intent": "Rules 3, 4: a trailing unpaired escape inside a quote invalidates all preceding valid labels.",
+      "input": "OK,\"BAD\\",
+      "expected": null
+    },
+    {
+      "id": "unclosed-quote-after-valid-labels",
+      "intent": "Rules 2, 4, 10: a quote opened mid-label and left unclosed invalidates previously valid labels.",
+      "input": "OK,ok,NEXT,PRE\"BAD,TAIL",
+      "expected": null
+    },
+    {
+      "id": "escaped-quote-does-not-close",
+      "intent": "Rules 2, 3, 4: an escaped final quote is literal and cannot close quoted mode.",
+      "input": "OK,\"BAD\\\"",
+      "expected": null
+    },
+    {
+      "id": "empty-normalization-cannot-hide-error",
+      "intent": "Rules 4, 9: empty and ordinary whitespace labels cannot suppress a later unclosed quote.",
+      "input": ",\"\", \t,\"",
+      "expected": null
+    }
+  ],
+  "properties": ["unique_nonempty_labels", "ascii_lowercase"],
+  "rationale": "The 24 deterministic ASCII cases cover all ten rules and their interactions. Expectations follow left-to-right delimiter and escape handling, retain per-character whitespace protection, trim only ordinary boundaries, collapse only ordinary runs, lowercase every emitted ASCII uppercase letter, then remove empty strings and deduplicate by exact equality in first occurrence order. Separate cases exercise all six whitespace characters as ordinary, quoted and escaped characters; empty quotes; protected run separators and boundaries; exact protected-only equality; literal ASCII controls; and paired escape parity. Malformed endings require whole-input ValueError even after valid, duplicate or empty labels, represented by null. No Unicode or non-string behavior is assumed."
+}
